structure.unit: Erection of Lines; Rights-Of-Way; Eminent Domain, Etc

law.catch_line: Preceding sections subject to repeal or change at pleasure
law.text: The preceding sections of this chapter and also §§ 56-466, 56-467 and 56-484 shall be subject to repeal, alteration, or modification, and the rights and privileges acquired thereunder shall be subject to revocation or modification by the General Assembly at its pleasure.
